title: Durable DB and CRUD Runtime
goal: Create a governed durable data layer for OS-owned founder/business records with staged schema, repository, write preview, Command Center UX, tests, docs, and final validation.
userImpact: Operators get a clear DB/CRUD path without live mutation until each boundary is validated.
commandCenterImpact: P134 preserves the DB Runtime Command Center UX and closes final validation without adding DB write, CRUD, provider, dispatch, project mutation, deploy, export, package, or spend controls.
safetyImpact: P134 closes with DB/runtime writes, live CRUD, migrations, raw SQL, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and spend blocked.
costImpact: No provider spend; local checks only.
